# Bony Amin

> A two-person design engineering studio. One senior designer and one senior engineer
> design, build and ship websites, web applications and digital products end to end —
> with no agency hand-offs, no translation loss between design and code, and no queue.

## Who it is for
Businesses that already have a product or website, or want to build a new one entirely.
Founders, product leads and marketing owners commissioning a build.

## What makes it different
Two senior people, both hands-on, covering the whole job from first sketch to live site.
Fixed price against fixed scope before work starts. The client owns every design file,
repository and account from day one. No proprietary CMS and no lock-in.

## Services
- Marketing and product websites
- Web applications
- Design systems
- Redesign and rebuild of existing products
- Design and engineering audits
- Ongoing monthly design and development support

## Engagements
- Launch — from $6,000, 2 to 3 weeks, a focused site of up to six pages.
- Product — $14,000 to $30,000, 4 to 8 weeks, a full product site or web application.
- Standing seat — from $3,500 per month, no minimum term, ongoing senior time.

## Working practice
Asynchronous by default with a weekly live call. Replies within one business day. One or
two projects at a time. Thirty days of post-launch support included with every project.
